en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> passed away, a she-camel of his<sup>asws</sup> came over from the pen until she struck herself upon the side of the grave and wallowed upon it. So I<sup>asws</sup> ordered with her, and she was returned to her pen, and that my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> had performed Hajj and Umrah upon her, and he<sup>asws</sup> had not whipped it with a whip at all’.
